profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II, Android at Doximity
profile.summary:
Leader and hard-worker with a remarkable capacity of adaptation based on the needs of the environment and agile search of solutions to the current problematics, along with the constant desire of learning and improving every day.
Experience on the development of applications in Android, Java and C#, business intelligence, database management, system software analysis, project management and software development.
Teamwork skills with great creative abilities that lead to the optimal performance of the job. Persistent and dedicated on achieving the expected results and motivated for new challenges.
I consider myself as a serious, responsible and competitive person.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · On-site
positions.description:
I was accountable for developing Android apps written in Java, integrated as subapps to the Citi Mobile app.
I was involved in the stages of planning, estimation, design, implementation and unit testing of projects using Scrum agile methodology.

Projects/Achievements:
- Creation of subapps written in Java using Android jetpack components, MVP and MVVM architectures.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was in charge of the mobile development area of the company, leading and developing different applications.
I was accountable for developing software projects mostly written in Java and C#, focused on biometrics authentication and financial transactions messaging. 
I was actively involved on the stages of requirements elicitation, technical proposals development, as well as planning, estimation and assignment of project tasks based on the Scrum agile methodology, assuming the role of Scrum Master for several projects.

Projects/Achievements:
- Development of Tekbees Unicus - Android module (Biometrics solution)
- Creation of EMV module in transactional switch written in Java
- Creation of web application written in Java used to enroll and verify users using biometrics authentication
- Development of mobile applications for casinos.
- Leadership on QA project aimed to perfom load testing and IT monitoring

projects.title: Politecnico Students' Mobile Application
projects.description: This project was developed during the course of "Mobile Application Development". It was aimed to develop a mobile application based on Android, which gathered several functionalities provided to the students of Politecnico di Torino.

projects.title: Optimization of STSP- Symmetric Travelling Salesman Problem
projects.description: This project was developed during the course of "Optimization Methods and Algorithms". It was aimed to optimize the problematic based on the use of Tabu Search and Genetic Algorithms, having a performance over a specified treshold.
